summary_1line: Pradyumna defeats and nearly kills Salwa but spares him by divine command; Krishna returns, learns of the attack on Dwaraka, and sets out to hunt Salwa.

image_candidates.scene_text: Pradyumna stands in his chariot drawing a blazing arrow like a venomous serpent while gods in the sky send Narada to stop him.
Krishna blows the white conch Panchajanya beside the ocean as Danava warriors fall from Salwa’s flying metal city into the waves.
Salwa’s aerial city hovers miles above the sea while torrents of arrows rain down on Krishna and his army below.
